name: chipvoice
description: Five classic sound chips in an AudioWorklet or offline: NES, Game Boy, Mega Drive, SNES and C64. Musical scores and sound effects that borrow hardware voices.
author: Gwendall Esnault (https://gwendall.com)

scripts.build: npm run worklet && node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.dev: npm run worklet && (npm run worklet -- --watch & tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --watch)
scripts.test:unit: node test/validate.mjs && node test/clock.mjs && node test/gb.mjs && node test/md.mjs && node test/snes.mjs && node test/c64.mjs && node test/driver.mjs && node test/transport.mjs && node test/event-queue.mjs && node test/hot-path.mjs && node test/recording.mjs && node test/gb-driver.mjs && node test/md-driver.mjs && node test/snes-driver.mjs && node test/c64-driver.mjs && node test/score.mjs && node test/vgm.mjs && node test/golden.mjs && node test/golden-dmg.mjs && node test/golden-md.mjs && node test/golden-snes.mjs && node test/golden-c64.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:fresh
